notes.title: Balance Update
notes.notes:
Another weekly update. The biggest change is the melee zone is moving to be the second zone. So, for melee people, they'll always get a melee run if they want.

Change-log:
- Swapping order of Zones 2 & 3.
- Zone 3 boss is now less bad.
- HE-Grenades now only obtainable by mutation.
- Chainsaw now blocks always but only recharges on kills.
- Fixed Hungry Bandit mutation conflicting with Melee mutations.
- Zone 4 is now longer and gets progressively harder.
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: CHAINSAW UPDATE
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=omJk0RbaTno;full][/previewyoutube]Another weekly update.

This update brings some new melee weapons like the chainsaw and balance tweaks for Zone 3.

Change-log:
- Added speical Zone 3 prize room with only melee weapons.
- Added chainsaw and bat melee weapons.
- Added more enemies to Zone 3.
- Added mutation that makes smoke deadly.
- Added mime skin.
- Zone 3 colors are now more bright.
- Zone 4 colors are now more readable.
- Less rail guns on Zone 2 to encourage grenades more.
- Can now kick enemy guns on Zone 3.
- Fixed Zone 2 boss saying the wrong thing sometimes.
- Fixed bug were enemies could shoot you off screen sometimes.
- Fixed camera shake when firing secondary weapons.
- Lotta shot mutation no longer effects rail guns.

notes.title: Minor tweaks & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Zone 3 now shorter but harder.
- Added page up and down to leaderboards.
- Leaderboards now have an error if no data.
- Fixed editor not showing in debug mode.
- Added some more signatures to Zone 0 & Zone 1.
- Enemy emotes now have shadows.
- All starter items in shop no buyable at 1-5.

notes.title: ⛲🐛 Some feature suggestions from community & bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Added a slider for cross hair radius when using controller.
- Adding tool tips in pause menu to explain gun/item mechanics.
- Added feature where player swaps similar guns that have more ammo automatically.
- Added a kill streak counter.
- Removed virtual cursor with axis stick.
- Fixed bug where trigger could rebind to negative motion.
- Fixed infinite slow mo glitch.

notes.title: Big controller support patch 🎮🩹
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who's tried the demo so far.
While the response so far has been great, I'm getting a lot of feedback suggesting the controller support needs some love. So that's exactly what the first patch does 😎

Thanks and if you have any suggestion, jump on the discord and ping me: https://discord.gg/VzYpD6r


Changes:
- Added analog precision when moving with left controller axis stick.
- Added a push force when rounding wall edges to make movement smoother on controller.
- Teleport destination now controlled by same bindings as movement.
- Teleport now flashes the teleport binding.
- Fixed bug where keyboard bindings would sometimes be shown in prompts when using controller in tutorial.
- Fixed bug where Pause menu was shown on right trigger.
- Zone 2-1 now a little easier.
